Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants, especially teen GDL drivers who face the strictest phone rules.
Why it matters to a first-timer: railroad crossing and school bus distances are classic exact-figure test items [A03] [A04], and the parking distances and phone fines in this section are equally specific.
Level: heavy exact-figure recall (feet, mph, hours, fines) plus a few judgment rules; high load because many distances look alike.
Prerequisites: the right-of-way and intersection rules from the previous section.
